newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks sag in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks sag in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stock prices sagged in early morning trade on Tuesday as the market returned from a long weekend.
Brokers said, however, that most participants in the market were sidelined, awaiting the outcome of the U.S. Federal Reserve's policy-setting meeting scheduled for later today.

At 0018 GMT, the Tokyo stock market's benchmark 225-issue Nikkei average was down 58.14 points or 0.28 percent at 21,054.10. In the futures market, the key December futures were down 60 points at 21,120.

"It's the end of the month and the market is waiting for the FOMC (Federal Open Market Committee)," said Yasuo Ueki, general manager at Nikko Securities. "There is not much incentive to buy aggressively today."
